description: Issue #145, the plainest negative: the acceptance criteria never mention a test, so nothing is raised even though the declared file is a shell script the derivation has no rule for. Without this case the detector could be a `scope has no test path` check wearing the name of a test-demand check, and every shell / Rust / SQL issue in the repository would stop dispatch. Both criteria are ordinary conditions, one per language, because the noun rule reads both.
